study.headline: Providing 24/7 support for Tesco’s key PLC sites
study.challenge: Tesco required round-the-clock support for six PLC sites providing essential investor information, with availability and fast incident resolution critical to protecting the company’s reputation.
approach: Partnered with Radley Yeldar to take responsibility for the Azure-hosted Umbraco sites.
Onboarded certified Azure and Umbraco engineers into a global follow-the-sun support rota.
Established monitoring, triage and escalation paths tuned to investor-relations publishing windows.
outcomes: Six multinational PLC sites supported around the clock
Smooth operations through critical investor-information publishing

others.headline: 24/7 coverage for a global endpoint platform
others.challenge: A fast-growing SaaS platform needed round-the-clock coverage across two continents without doubling headcount, and their incident response times were drifting as the product scaled.
approach: Mapped the full service catalogue and instrumented every user-facing journey with actionable alerts.
Set up a follow-the-sun rotation pairing our EU and support pods with their in-house escalation engineers.
Introduced blameless post-incident reviews that fed directly into their engineering backlog.
outcomes: 82% reduction in out-of-hours escalation to client engineers
Median incident acknowledgement under 4 minutes, around the clock
Measurable drop in repeat incidents quarter over quarter

others.headline: Hardened payroll infrastructure for peak windows
others.challenge: Payroll runs are unforgiving: massive scheduled bursts of load, zero tolerance for missed deadlines, and a compliance environment that punishes surprises.
approach: Rebuilt the deployment pipeline with automated rollback and progressive delivery for payroll services.
Load-tested every release against simulated peak windows before it could reach production.
Implemented pre-run health checks that block a payroll cycle from starting on a degraded cluster.
outcomes: Zero missed payroll windows across 14 months
Release confidence high enough to deploy during business hours
Pre-run checks catching degradation before every major cycle

others.headline: Managed cloud migration with zero downtime
others.challenge: A legal workflow platform on ageing infrastructure needed to move to managed cloud without a maintenance window their clients would accept.
approach: Ran a well-architected review and rebuilt the environment as infrastructure-as-code.
Migrated in waves behind traffic switching, with instant rollback paths at every step.
Left behind runbooks and architecture documentation the internal team actually uses.
outcomes: Migration completed with zero customer-visible downtime
Environment rebuild time cut from days to under an hour
